result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation are aligned and readable. I found two minor cosmetic issues: a decorative shape leaking past the promo banner's rounded corner, and inconsistent styling of the restaurant metadata row. No critical or major defects are visible.

issues.description: In the green promo banner ('3 free deliveries for you'), a decorative circle appears to extend past the banner's rounded bottom-right corner. This leaves a small dark sliver or artifact at the corner, so the rounded edge looks uneven.
issues.suggestion: Apply overflow: hidden (or a clip path with the same border radius) to the banner container so decorative shapes are clipped to the rounded corners.

issues.description: The metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' ('25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') is rendered in a heavier weight and larger size than the equivalent secondary text in the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g., '€0.90 delivery'). This makes the typography hierarchy inconsistent between sections.
issues.suggestion: Use the same secondary text style (regular weight, smaller size, muted gray) for restaurant metadata across all sections.
